artifact_policy: Retain the exact generated train/development prompts and graph proofs, prompt hashes, model/tokenizer fingerprints, action-token IDs, hidden features, per-seed adapters, all checkpoint metrics, resource measurements, runner/auditor snapshots, summary, and SHA-256 manifest. Never include employer-specific framing.
claim_boundary: A pass supports only a CPU-trained binary action-head preference-optimization mechanism on this procedural implication task and the frozen generator/template distributions. It is synthetic E2 evidence only; it is not real-task improvement, broad reasoning, human preference optimization, online RL, or general capability.

compute_limits.device: CPU only; CUDA and MPS are forbidden

data.generator: Counter-based SHA-256 keyed procedural DAG entailment generator; labels are determined by independently replayable transitive closure, not by row index or model output.
data.pilot_exclusion: Exclude all prompts and seeds from private exploratory pilots 20261009 and 20261010 using the committed prompt-hash denylist. Retire draft confirmation seeds 20261013 and 20261014: a pre-run generator smoke check materialized those synthetic prompts before protocol commit, without scoring or inspecting outcomes. Runtime rejects any formal cohort that reuses either retired seed.

confirmation_reservation.access_rule: The confirmation prompts must not be generated, tokenized, or scored unless the frozen development gate passes and a separate confirmation lock has been committed. The prior-shift cohort is secondary and cannot replace the balanced primary endpoint.

data.independence: The four seed streams are distinct. Within each stream the label allocation, graph construction, predicate permutation, rule order, and presentation order use separate SHA-256 domains. The generator proves all labels by graph closure and records prompt hashes. Train, development, balanced confirmation, and shifted confirmation prompt-hash sets must be pairwise disjoint.

learner.action_space: Exactly two first-token actions after the frozen Qwen chat-template assistant prefix: Yes (token ID verified from the exact prefix at runtime) and No (token ID verified from the exact prefix at runtime). The policy is normalized over these two actions; no free-form generation is scored.
learner.reference: Frozen base model's conditional Yes/No action distribution.
learner.context_features: Frozen base-model final assistant-prefix hidden state, standardized using training-cohort mean and standard deviation only.
learner.adapter: Scalar calibration adds one learned constant to the Yes-minus-No logit. Contextual adapters add a learned affine function of the standardized hidden state to that binary logit; the transformer and output head remain frozen.
arms: calibration_only: scalar offset optimized by binary cross entropy on the training labels
context_sft: contextual affine action-logit adapter optimized by binary cross entropy
context_dpo: the same contextual adapter optimized by pairwise DPO with the verifier-correct action chosen and the other binary action rejected
learner.dpo_objective: For each binary prompt, delta is the contextual adapter's change to the frozen Yes-minus-No logit and sign is +1 for a correct Yes or -1 for a correct No. Minimize mean softplus(-beta * sign * delta), equivalent to DPO's chosen/rejected log-ratio objective in the normalized two-action policy.
learner.shuffle: Deterministic per seed; contextual_sft and context_dpo share initialization and minibatch order.
learner.checkpoint_selection: Select each trained arm's checkpoint by development balanced accuracy; ties select fewer updates. Do not alter the locked grid, optimizer, prompt, or cohorts after seeing results.

metrics.primary: Development balanced accuracy difference between selected context_dpo and calibration_only, paired over the same generated prompts and averaged across the three training seeds.
secondary: selected context_dpo versus the frozen base balanced accuracy
selected context_dpo versus matched context_sft balanced accuracy
plain accuracy, balanced accuracy, per-class recall and support, macro-F1, binary action NLL and conditional Bernoulli KL to the base policy
per-seed results, parameter deltas, update count, runtime, and peak RSS

paired_bootstrap.method: Resample prompts within gold class; average each arm's per-prompt correctness across seeds before computing the arm difference.

metrics.confirmation_gate: If development passes, freeze a separate confirmation lock before generating confirmation prompts. Apply the same numeric gate to the balanced 512-prompt confirmation cohort. The shifted-prior cohort is secondary: report balanced and plain accuracy, per-class recall, and all arm metrics without changing the primary pass decision.
metrics.interpretation: The earlier intercept-only gain was post-hoc and is hypothesis-generating only. No effect size from either private pilot sets this gate. A confirmation pass would remain synthetic E2 evidence and would not close the real-task or external-reproduction gaps.

purpose: Test prospectively whether a context-dependent verifier-derived DPO update adds held-out task accuracy beyond a scalar Yes/No prior correction, with matched supervised action learning and a shifted-prior challenge cohort.
